name: openwebui-auth
description: OpenWebUI OIDC auth for AI coding agents — core + opencode + pi adapters

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build && bun run --cwd packages/pi build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/opencode typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/pi typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/opencode test && bun run --cwd packages/pi test
